claim_boundary: This protocol registers a no-training weighted-density bridge inside the existing molecular HNC scalar. It is a mathematical cavity/pressure candidate, not a physical solvent asset, total solvation calculation, chemistry score, force/PES result, or accuracy claim.

construction.name: route2-v0-molecular-weighted-density-bridge-v1
construction.centre_projection: rho = D nu, with D nu_bulk = rho_bulk and dv <q, D d> = sum_i w_i (D^T q)_i d_i
construction.weighted_density: rho_bar = K rho, where K is real, nonnegative, normalized, and periodic-even
construction.response_rule: the bridge gradient and Hessian are exact derivatives of F_B; no response symmetrization, clipping, or damping is a model term
construction.homogeneous_phase_gate: Before planar-interface use, evaluate nu_x=x nu_bulk from the exact HNC-plus-bridge scalar. Require zero external potential, full configuration gradient stationarity and uniformity, positive homogeneous curvatures, and |omega(x_gas)-omega(1)| within a frozen coexistence tolerance; a zero of the projected ray derivative alone is insufficient.

pure_solvent_anchor_contract.cubic_coefficient: Derived exactly from the matching molecular-HNC vacuum-limit pressure, the frozen bulk molecular density, and the independently declared pure-liquid pressure. It is never a fitted field.
pure_solvent_anchor_contract.quartic_coefficient: Must be fixed before target-solute execution by one content-addressed pure-solvent homogeneous-phase-plus-planar-interface certificate that first establishes a stable coexisting liquid/gas pair and then reproduces an independently sourced surface tension using the declared scalar. It cannot be optimized against solvation values.
pure_solvent_anchor_contract.weighted_density_kernel: Must be content-addressed and derived from the frozen pure-liquid correlation/length-scale convention before target-solute execution; it cannot be selected from cavity or solvation errors.
required_certificate_contents: all-atom solvent model and source digest
temperature, pressure, and bulk molecular number density
source-provenanced direct correlation or classical-liquid functional
independent pure-liquid surface tension and units
periodic-even normalized K kernel and source/derivation
A_s pressure identity and B_s planar-interface residual
exact SI-to-atomic-unit pressure and surface-tension identities
all frozen solvent-source hashes plus canonical float64/grid digests for D and K
same-scalar homogeneous liquid/gas coexistence evidence: zero external potential, full-gradient residuals, uniformity residuals, positive curvatures, and the grand-potential-density gap
B_low/B_root/B_high, all three stationary residuals, interface count, transverse area, and coarse/fine grid convergence
explicit evidence scope: synthetic-control or physical-pure-liquid-admission; only the latter may enter a physical endpoint
statement that no MNSol, FreeSolv, development, confirmation, or blind solvation values were read
pure_solvent_anchor_contract.source_bound_constructor: A source-bound bridge asset must be built only from a parsed route2-v0-pure-solvent-bridge-certificate-v1 record whose frozen source hashes, HNC pressure, molecular bulk density, D digest, and K digest exactly match the live scalar. Direct synthetic constructors remain derivative controls. A physical-pure-liquid-admission record must additionally carry parser-validated same-scalar homogeneous phase-coexistence evidence; a source-bound synthetic-control certificate cannot establish a physical-liquid or accuracy claim, and any physical endpoint must reject a source asset that explicitly says physical liquid is not claimed.

planar_interface_quartic_resolution.stationary_surface_tension: After same-scalar homogeneous coexistence passes, gamma(B_s) = [Omega_B_s[nu_B_s^*] - V_liquid omega(1) - V_gas omega(x_gas)] / (N_interface A), with nu_B_s^* stationary under declared planar boundary conditions and the same frozen HNC, D, and K operators.
planar_interface_quartic_resolution.envelope_derivative: No generic signed d gamma / d B_s is admitted under the current contract: varying B_s can move the finite-density gas phase or destroy coexistence at fixed chemical potential. A future derivative requires a predeclared coexistence-preserving chemical-potential path, dividing-surface convention, and complete same-scalar bulk subtractions.
planar_interface_quartic_resolution.strict_monotonicity: No positivity-only monotonicity or uniqueness claim is admissible. The empty-gas integral omits finite-density bulk terms, and a physical certificate must preserve a predeclared stationary branch, a coexistence-preserving/root-selection protocol, and homogeneous coexistence evidence.
planar_interface_quartic_resolution.certificate_rule: Before target-solute execution, require same-scalar liquid/gas coexistence, freeze B_low >= 0, B_high, gamma(B_low), gamma(B_high), gamma_target, planar stationarity residuals, transverse-area convention, interface count, grid-refinement evidence, and a predeclared branch-selection rule. Require min(gamma(B_low), gamma(B_high)) <= gamma_target <= max(gamma(B_low), gamma(B_high)) and a declared root residual.
planar_interface_quartic_resolution.prohibited_selection: The bracket may be constructed only from the same pure-liquid scalar and an independently sourced pure-liquid surface tension. No MNSol, FreeSolv, development, confirmation, blind, solute cavity, or solvation-error value may enter B_s, K, or the bracket.

custom_solvent_contract.dielectric_only: A solvent name, static dielectric, or optical dielectric alone is insufficient and must fail closed for bridge or total-free-energy use.
required_before_total_free_energy: complete all-atom molecular/site model and geometry
temperature, pressure, bulk molecular number density, and independent pure-liquid surface tension
frozen bulk direct correlation or a declared molecular liquid functional
source-bound molecular-centre projection and periodic-even weighted-density kernel
same-scalar homogeneous liquid/gas coexistence evidence before a planar surface-tension root
certificate-derived cubic and quartic bridge coefficients
complete MACE-native solute-solvent external-potential, standard-state, force, and grid/orientation convergence contracts

validation_sequence: Verify D maps the uniform configuration density to the molecular bulk density and prove its exact discrete adjoint pairing.
Verify K has unit discrete integral, periodic inversion symmetry, and an exact self-adjoint convolution pairing.
Verify the cubic coefficient from P_HNC and P_s exactly restores the declared same-functional vacuum-limit pressure.

Verify the exact no-solute homogeneous liquid/gas phase gate: zero external potential, full configuration-space stationarity, gradient uniformity, positive curvatures, and grand-potential-density coexistence. Do not treat the vacuum-limit pressure identity as coexistence.
Verify bridge scalar, gradient, Hessian-vector action, Hessian reciprocity, and scalar second derivative by finite differences before any solvent asset is admitted.

For the quartic coefficient, verify a source-frozen stationary planar branch only after the homogeneous coexistence gate, retain endpoint/root/residual/grid evidence plus a predeclared branch-selection rule, and do not infer uniqueness from a positivity-only envelope argument.
For each physical solvent, verify the frozen pure-liquid planar-interface/surface-tension certificate before any target-solute label is read.
Verify the full HNC-plus-bridge stationary liquid scalar, stability, forces, grid/orientation convergence, standard state, and 11-solvent asset panel before chemistry scoring.
Apply the already frozen all-record development, confirmation, and external-blind maximum-error gates without any bridge, kernel, or liquid-asset change.
decision_rule: A failed pure-solvent certificate, homogeneous-phase coexistence gate, scalar/derivative identity, source digest, structural gate, or accuracy gate rejects this frozen candidate. It does not authorize a post-hoc PC+, a changed B_s or K, a cavity/radius adjustment, a solvation-label regression, post-training, fine-tuning, or per-record method selection. A new bridge functional requires a new preregistration and independent review.
